title: CXIII. The Stranger entertained in GOD's Houſe of Prayer. Iſaiah lvi. 6, 7. compared with Matt. xxi. 13. and Eph. ii. 19.

segments.text:
1
GREAT Father of Mankind,
We bleſs that wond'rous Grace,
Which could for Gentiles find
Within thy Courts a Place.
How kind the Care
Our GOD diſplays,
For us to raiſe
An Houſe of Pray'r!

2
Tho' once eſtranged far,
We now approach the Throne;
For Jeſus brings us near,
And makes our Cauſe his own:
Strangers no more,
To thee we come,
And find our Home,
And reſt ſecure.

3
To thee our Souls we join,
And love thy ſacred Name;
No more our own, but thine,
We triumph in thy Claim;
Our Father King,
Thy Cov'nant-Grace
Our Souls embrace,
Thy Titles ſing.

4
Here in thy Houſe we feaſt
On Dainties all divine;
And, while ſuch Sweets we taſte,
With Joy our Faces ſhine.
Incenſe ſhall riſe
From Flames of Love,
And GOD approve
The Sacrifice.

5
May all the Nations throng
To worſhip in thy Houſe;
And thou attend the Song,
And ſmile upon their Vows;
Indulgent ſtill,
Till Earth conſpire
To join the Choir
On Zion's Hill.
